evals.name: adv-offer
evals.prompt: I clean out garages and haul junk. Competitors charge $300 a load. Build me a Grand Slam Offer using $100M Offers: dream outcome, problems, solutions, delivery vehicles, trim and stack, plus pricing, guarantee and a MAGIC name.
assertions: Follows the five-step build: dream outcome, problems, solutions, delivery vehicles, trim and stack
Uses the Value Equation (dream outcome, likelihood, time delay, effort)
Recommends premium pricing rather than undercutting $300
Includes a specific guarantee and scarcity/urgency and bonuses

evals.name: adv-market
evals.prompt: Rank these markets for a new coaching offer using Hormozi's starving-crowd criteria: (a) busy moms wanting to lose weight, (b) dentists wanting more patients, (c) teenagers wanting to learn guitar.
assertions: Uses the four criteria: massive pain, purchasing power, easy to target, growing
Scores each market on the criteria
Ranks dentists high on purchasing power and targetability and teens low on purchasing power
Notes market matters more than offer or persuasion (order of importance)
Gives a clear final ranking with reasoning
